name: Sydney Opera House
description: Shell-like roofs sit on Bennelong Point beside Sydney Harbour Bridge.

name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
description: A steel arch bridge with climbable arches spanning the harbour.

name: Parliament House
description: Australia’s parliament sits under a grassed roof on Capital Hill.

name: Shrine of Remembrance
description: A war memorial on St Kilda Road with a ray of light on Remembrance Day.

name: Story Bridge
description: A steel cantilever bridge over the Brisbane River with climb experiences.

name: Uluru
description: A vast sandstone monolith in the Red Centre — climb closed; base walks open.

name: Great Barrier Reef
description: Coral reefs off Queensland reached by reef boats and pontoons.

name: Twelve Apostles
description: Limestone stacks rise offshore along Victoria’s Great Ocean Road.

name: Blue Mountains
description: Eucalyptus valleys and lookouts west of Sydney, including the Three Sisters.

name: Kakadu National Park
description: Wetlands, rock art and waterfalls in a vast Top End park.

name: Queen Victoria Market
description: A historic open market for produce, deli goods and weekend stalls.

name: Adelaide Central Market
description: A covered market known for fresh produce and multicultural food.

name: Sydney Fish Market
description: Wholesale and retail seafood with sushi bars beside Blackwattle Bay.

name: Fremantle Markets
description: A Victorian market hall of crafts and food near Perth’s port.

name: Davies Park / West End markets
description: Weekend markets and cafés in Brisbane’s West End.

name: Sydney New Year’s Eve
description: Harbour fireworks launched from barges and bridges each 31 December.
